name: Real-Time Payments
who_it_suits: customers who need money to arrive within seconds
key_numbers: €1.00 fee per transfer, arrives within seconds, limit €2,500 per transaction and €5,000 per rolling 24 hours

name: SEPA Credit Transfer
who_it_suits: customers sending money who are not in a hurry
key_numbers: free, settles by the next business day, limit €10,000 per day and €25,000 per rolling 7 days

name: Wire Transfer
who_it_suits: customers sending large or international payments outside the SEPA area
key_numbers: €25 domestic fee, €45 international fee, €10 incoming fee, same business day domestic

name: Personal Loan
who_it_suits: customers borrowing for a car, renovation, or other large purchase that is not property
key_numbers: €1,000 to €50,000, APR 7.99% to 21.99%, 12-60 month terms, approval within 1 business day

name: Student Loan
who_it_suits: students needing new borrowing for tuition or living costs
key_numbers: €2,000 to €40,000 per academic year, APR 5.5% to 8.5%, repayments start 6 months after graduation

name: Student Loan Refinance
who_it_suits: graduates who already have student loans and want to combine them, potentially at a lower rate
key_numbers: €5,000 minimum to refinance, fixed APR 4.5% to 9.99%, terms of 5 to 20 years

name: Home Loan
who_it_suits: customers buying or building a home in Ireland, including a second home
key_numbers: €50,000 to €1,000,000, up to 35 year term, fixed 3.95%-4.75% or variable 4.15%-4.95%, 10% deposit (20% for a second home)

name: Mobile Cheque Deposit
purposes: banking a cheque without a branch
key_numbers: up to €5,000 per cheque, €10,000 per rolling 30 days, first €225 available next business day

name: Overdraft Protection
who_it_suits: customers who occasionally risk a negative current account balance
key_numbers: €5 fee per linked-account transfer, €30 overdraft fee otherwise, up to 4 fees per day

name: High-Yield Savings
who_it_suits: customers who want to grow a balance without actively investing it
key_numbers: 3.50% Annual Equivalent Rate, no minimum balance, no monthly fee

name: Rewards Credit Card
who_it_suits: customers who want cash back on everyday spending
key_numbers: 3% cashback on groceries and dining, 2% transport, 1% other, no fee in year one then €50/year

name: Pension (PRSA)
who_it_suits: customers saving for retirement outside or alongside a workplace pension
key_numbers: income tax relief 15%-40% depending on age, no account or annual fee, withdrawals from age 60

name: Opening an Account
who_it_suits: new customers who do not yet have an Aisling Bank account
key_numbers: 18+, Irish or EU resident, ID and proof of address, approved within 1 business day, no fee to open
